stem: A client is drawing HUMULIN R U-100 insulin from a vial for subcutaneous injection. Which syringe should the nurse instruct the client to use?

options.A: A U-100 insulin syringe calibrated for U-100 insulin.
options.B: Any 1-mL syringe because insulin units and milliliters are interchangeable.
options.C: A tuberculin syringe without a prescribed unit-to-volume conversion plan.
options.D: Any syringe chosen only by needle length because barrel calibration does not affect dosing.

rationale: HUMULIN R U-100 contains 100 units/mL. Its Instructions for Use specify a U-100 insulin syringe and warn that use of the wrong syringe can cause dosing errors. A is correct.
educational_objective: Use a U-100 insulin syringe with vial-based U-100 insulin to avoid unit-to-volume dosing errors.

source_original.stem: A client uses U-100 insulin and asks whether an old 1 mL tuberculin syringe can routinely replace a U-100 insulin syringe for self-administration. Which teaching is safest?

options.A: Use a U-100 insulin syringe for U-100 insulin to minimize unit-to-volume dosing errors
options.B: Use any one-milliliter syringe because insulin units and milliliters are interchangeable
options.C: Use a tuberculin syringe routinely without a prescribed unit-to-volume conversion plan
options.D: Select the syringe only by needle length because barrel calibration does not affect dosing

source_original.rationale: U-100 insulin syringes are calibrated in insulin units for 100 units/mL insulin and reduce the need for manual unit-to-volume conversion. A tuberculin syringe measures milliliters, so routine substitution without explicit professional conversion instructions creates avoidable dosing-error risk.
source_original.source_detail: Dosage/administration and device instructions: U-100 insulin is measured in units with compatible U-100 delivery devices; mismatched volume/unit conversion can cause dosing error; accessed 2026-08-14.

correction_summary: Anchored the item to a specific HUMULIN R U-100 vial label rather than a generic search page and reduced the stem to the exact device-selection decision supported by the Instructions for Use.
